H1_BBO_IMBALANCE.observation: first valid eligible BBO at or after T0

H2_PRE30_OFI.formula: sum(e_n), where e_n = I(bid_n >= bid_n-1)*bid_size_n - I(bid_n <= bid_n-1)*bid_size_n-1 - I(ask_n <= ask_n-1)*ask_size_n + I(ask_n >= ask_n-1)*ask_size_n-1
H2_PRE30_OFI.sign_convention: positive is net displayed bid-side pressure; negative is net displayed ask-side pressure
H2_PRE30_OFI.transition_rule: include only consecutive valid BBO observations whose two event timestamps are both in [T0-30s, T0); do not carry in, interpolate, or forward-fill

H3_WEIGHTED_MID_DISPLACEMENT.name_constraint: mechanical weighted mid; never Stoikov micro-price
H3_WEIGHTED_MID_DISPLACEMENT.observation: same first valid eligible BBO at or after T0 used by H1

classification.ABSTAIN: pressure == 0 or pressure/response invalid or the window overlaps a recorded gap

H4_FLOW_RESPONSE_MISMATCH.response: last valid pre-T0 midpoint minus first valid midpoint in [T0-30s, T0)

H5_M1C_INTERACTION.claim_constraint: M1C is not directional; never compare a result to the same direction as M1C
H5_M1C_INTERACTION.test: whether H1-H4 differ across the already-frozen M1C families

market_structure_strata.one_tick_spread: ask-bid equals the applicable frozen instrument minimum price variation
market_structure_strata.unknown_tick_rule: ABSTAIN from the stratum; never infer from a future sample outcome
market_structure_strata.wider_than_one_tick_spread: ask-bid is greater than the applicable frozen instrument minimum price variation

outcomes.primary_microstructure_endpoint: direction of the next non-zero valid midpoint change after T0
outcomes.secondary_m1c_relevance_endpoint: signed underlying return at T0+15 minutes
outcomes.secondary_reference_rule: first valid eligible midpoint at/after T0 to last valid eligible midpoint at/before T0+15m; ABSTAIN when a gap prevents the endpoint

stopping_rule: exactly 20 complete eligible XNYS sessions; never extend or stop based on directional results
